Conversation · Lesson 03
في المطعمFi el-mat3am
🍽️ At the Restaurant

At a Restaurant in Tunisian Arabic

Learn how to ask for a menu, get a recommendation, explain your preferences and order a meal in Tunisian Arabic.

1. Listen first
2. Reusable chunks
3. Quick react
4. Live role-play
Step 01 & 02

The Mini-Dialogue

12 dialogue lines

Listen first: Listen before reading. Notice the sounds and rhythm, then open the transcript when you are ready.

Playing audio
Waiter

عسلامة، مرحبا بيك! تفضّل.

3aslema, mar7ba bik! Tfadhdhel.

Hello, welcome! Come in / have a seat.

Customer

عيشك! عندكم menu؟

3aychek! 3andkom menu?

Thank you! Do you have a menu?

Waiter

إي، تفضّل.

Ey, tfadhdhel.

Yes, here you go.

Customer

هاذي أوّل مرّة نجي لتونس. شنوة تنصحني ناكل؟

Hedhi awwel marra nji l-Tounes. Chnowa tensa7ni nekel?

This is my first time in Tunisia. What do you recommend I eat?

Waiter

ننصحك بالكسكسي. وزادة عنا بريك، سلاطة مشويّة وشربة فريك.

Nensa7ek bel-kosksi. W zeda 3anna brik, slata mechwiya w chorbet frik.

I recommend couscous. We also have brik, grilled salad and frik soup.

Customer

هههه، برشا ماكلة! والماكلة التونسيّة بنينة؟

Hahaha, barcha mekla! Wel-mekla et-tounsiya bnina?

Haha, so much food! Is Tunisian food tasty?

Waiter

إي، بنينة برشا! أمّا ساعات حارّة. إنتي تاكل الحار؟

Ey, bnina barcha! Amma se3at 7arra. Enti tekel el-7arr?

Yes, very tasty! But sometimes spicy. Do you eat spicy food?

Customer

لا، ما نحبّش الماكلة الحارّة.

Le, ma n7ebbech el-mekla el-7arra.

No, I don’t like spicy food.

Waiter

باهي، ما فما حتّى مشكل. شنوة تحب تاكل؟

Behi, ma famma 7atta mochkel. Chnowa t7eb tekel?

Okay, no problem at all. What would you like to eat?

Customer

نحب نجرب كسكسي موش حار وبريك، عيشك.

N7eb njarreb kosksi mouch 7arr w brik, 3aychek.

I’d like to try couscous that isn’t spicy and a brik, please.

Waiter

تفضّل، صحّة وبالشفاء!

Tfadhdhel, sa77a w bechfe!

Here you go. Enjoy your meal!

Customer

عيشك!

3aychek!

Thank you!

Step 04

Conversation Patterns

Try your own answer

Notice the question-and-answer patterns. Change the dish to make your own order.

Pattern 01 · Ordering
Question:

شنوة تحب تاكل؟

Chnowa t7eb tekel?

What would you like to eat?

نحب نجرب كسكسي، عيشك.

N7eb njarreb kosksi, 3aychek.

I’d like to try couscous, please.

Pattern 02 · Asking for advice

شنوة تنصحني ناكل؟

Chnowa tensa7ni nekel?

What do you recommend I eat?

ننصحك بالكسكسي.

Nensa7ek bel-kosksi.

I recommend couscous.

Pattern 03 · Your preference

إنتي تاكل الحار؟

Enti tekel el-7arr?

Do you eat spicy food?

لا، ما نحبّش الماكلة الحارّة.

Le, ma n7ebbech el-mekla el-7arra.

No, I don’t like spicy food.

Step 06

What Would You Say?

No multiple choice

Say your answer aloud before revealing the key answer.

You have just arrived. Ask the waiter for a menu.

عيشك! عندكم menu؟

3aychek! 3andkom menu?

Thank you! Do you have a menu?

This is your first time in Tunisia. Ask for a food recommendation.

هاذي أوّل مرّة نجي لتونس. شنوة تنصحني ناكل؟

Hedhi awwel marra nji l-Tounes. Chnowa tensa7ni nekel?

This is my first time in Tunisia. What do you recommend I eat?

You don’t like spicy food. Tell the waiter, then order couscous that isn’t spicy and a brik.

لا، ما نحبّش الماكلة الحارّة.

Le, ma n7ebbech el-mekla el-7arra.

No, I don’t like spicy food.

نحب نجرب كسكسي موش حار وبريك، عيشك.

N7eb njarreb kosksi mouch 7arr w brik, 3aychek.

I’d like to try couscous that isn’t spicy and a brik, please.

Step 08

Role-Play: Your Turn!

Final Challenge
🇹🇳

Virtual Encounter with the Waiter

The waiter will guide the conversation. Read your objective, say your reply aloud, then play the key answer and continue.

W
Waiter

عسلامة، مرحبا بيك! تفضّل.

3aslema, mar7ba bik! Tfadhdhel.

Your Objective: Step 1 of 6

Thank the waiter and ask for a menu.

🇹🇳
Cultural Insight

A warm welcome at the table

تفضّل

Tfadhdhel

Come in / have a seat · Here you go

At the start, the waiter uses this expression to welcome the customer. When offering the menu or serving the food, it means “here you go.”

صحّة وبالشفاء!

Sa77a w bechfe!

Enjoy your meal!

The customer answers with a simple thank you:

عيشك!

3aychek!

Thank you!
